# Execord - Natural Language Discord Automation Bot

> Execord is an AI-powered Discord agent that allows server administrators to manage their entire server using natural language prompts instead of complex slash commands.

## Overview
Execord converts plain text instructions into structured multi-step Discord API actions using an Orchestrator and domain-specific Sub-Agents (channels, roles, members, threads, messages, categories, automations).

## Core Capabilities & Features
- **Server Architecture:** Create, edit, move, or delete channels, categories, and voice/forum channels with custom topics, slowmodes, bitrate, and user limits.
- **Role & Permission Management:** Create hex-colored roles (e.g. `#FFD700`), set hoist/mention properties, and configure complex channel permission overwrites for roles or members.
- **Instant Moderation:** Timeout users (1 min to 28 days), kick members, ban users with audit log reasons, bulk-unban by User ID, and purge message history.
- **AI Support Tickets & Automations:** Deploy 24/7 AI-powered ticket panels with interactive buttons, automated private channels (`ticket-username`), custom knowledge/instructions injection, and full lifecycle automation management.
- **Messaging & Communication:** Send text or image messages, pin important posts, send private (ephemeral) responses, or bulk-purge messages.
- **Thread Management:** Create, lock, archive, or configure slowmodes for public, private, or forum threads.
- **AI Image Generation & Server Branding:** Generate custom graphics via AI text prompts and automatically apply them as server icons, banners, role icons, or channel attachments.
- **Audit & Analytics:** Query past server audit logs, read channel message history, inspect member lists, and analyze server configuration.

## Commands & Usage
Execord operates primarily through Discord slash commands:
- `/execute prompt:[text]` - Executes natural language instructions on the server (e.g. `/execute prompt:create a VIP role in gold and assign it to @User`).
- `/resume` - Resumes a paused execution from where you left off when limits reset.
- `/account` - Displays account status, daily token balance, and usage limits.
- `/premium` - Displays Free, Pro, and Ultra plan comparisons with direct Whop checkout buttons.
- `/referral` - View and manage your referral link to earn bonus tokens and subscription rewards.
- `/vote` - Vote on Top.gg to earn 10,000 daily bonus tokens.
- `/status` - Displays system health, latency, uptime, and guild stats.
- `/help` - Displays the interactive help menu and command guide.

## Example Prompts
- *"Create a community category with a general chat and 3 voice channels."*
- *"Create a 'Support' category, a #tickets channel, and an AI ticket panel with instructions 'Verification happens in #verify. For partnerships and member reports, tell users to wait for staff'."*
- *"Timeout @User for 1 hour for violating community rules."*
- *"Create a 'VIP' role in gold (#FFD700) and give it to @User."*
- *"Generate a futuristic shield icon and set it as the server icon."*
- *"Create an announcements channel that only the @Admin role can write in."*
- *"List all active automations on the server."*
